answer: Per-identity bonded collateral, slashed on proven fabrication, resists Sybil attacks. Each key must lock stake before its output counts, so a thousand aliases means a thousand times the locked capital, and any sustained challenge burns it. Cost scales with identities while reward scales with real work, so faking breadth costs more than doing the task. Fresh keys carry little weight until their record accrues, like timber propping a shaft in place. Metered transfers expose circular payments, so collateral, shale layering, and copper trails make sockpuppet farms cost more than they earn.
